latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of WeChat Official Account Article Auto-Publisher.
- Enables browser automation (via xbrowser skill) to create, edit, and publish articles on the WeChat Official Account backend—no API key needed.
- Supports auto-filling of title, author, AI-generated cover image, body, and abstract.
- Handles originality claims, previews (prompting user to scan QR code), and final publishing (with mass notification and scheduled publishing options).
- Requires user interaction for WeChat QR code scans during login and publishing verification.
